query:
SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(SUM(hit_tokens + miss_tokens), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
                    ELSE SUM(hit_tokens)::float8 / SUM(hit_tokens + miss_tokens)::float8
                END AS "ratio?"
            FROM tk_ledger
            WHERE route = $1
              AND ts >= $2
